# @arki/money

> Exact money for every JavaScript runtime: whole-unit amounts, no default rounding, ISO 4217 table shipped, strict parsing, exact conversion, Stripe units, Zod and Drizzle. It is not a ledger and not a float calculator.

Never pass a float. Build amounts from strings and pass a rounding mode to every step that may be inexact.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/money`: `AmountOutOfRange`, `Currency`, `CurrencyMismatchError`, `DivisionByZeroError`, `EmptyDataError`, `ExchangeRateError`, `Factor`, `ISO_4217_VERSION`, `InputTooLarge`, `InvalidArgumentError`, `InvalidMoneyShape`, `InvalidMoneyText`; and 39 more.
- `@arki/money/currency`: Currencies. `Currency`, `ISO_4217_VERSION`, `assertSameCurrency`, `requireCurrency`, `toCurrency`; types `CurrencyDefinition`, `CurrencyLike`.
- `@arki/money/errors`: Every failure this package raises on purpose extends `MathError` from `@arki/math`, so one `instanceof MathError` catches both libraries. `CurrencyMismatchError`, `DivisionByZeroError`, `EmptyDataError`, `ExchangeRateError`, `InvalidArgumentError`, `MONEY_ERROR_CODES`, `MathError`, `MoneyError`, `NumberFormatError`, `NumericRangeError`, `ProviderAmountError`, `ResourceLimitError`; and 4 more.
- `@arki/money/exact`: Bridges to `@arki/math`'s exact types, for multi-step math that should round only once at the end:. `toDecimal`, `toRational`.
- `@arki/money/format`: Localized display through `Intl.NumberFormat`. `createMoneyFormatter`, `formatMoney`, `formatMoneyToParts`; types `FormatOptions`, `MoneyFormatter`.
- `@arki/money/parse`: Strict parsing of money typed by people: `'1.234,56 €'` in German, `'$1,234.56'` in English, `'₹1,23,456.78'` in Indian English. `createMoneyParser`, `parseMoney`; types `MoneyParser`, `ParseOptions`, `ParseSymbols`.
- `@arki/money/exchange`: Currency conversion with exact rates. `Converter`, `ExchangeRate`, `convert`, `createConverter`, `exchangeRate`, `ratesFrom`; types `ConverterOptions`, `RateTable`.
- `@arki/money/provider`: Payment providers count amounts in their own units, which are not always ISO's. `fromProviderUnits`, `toProviderUnits`; types `ProviderUnitRule`.
- `@arki/money/stripe`: Stripe amounts. `STRIPE_RULES_VERSION`, `fromStripeAmount`, `stripeRule`, `toStripe`, `toStripeAmount`; types `StripeOperation`.
- `@arki/money/rational`: Exact in-between money. `RationalMoney`, `isRationalMoney`; types `ExactMoney`.
- `@arki/money/bag`: A wallet of several currencies: `10 EUR + 5 USD` stays two balances. `MoneyBag`.
- `@arki/money/zod`: Zod 4 schemas that turn input into `Money`. `anyMoneySchema`, `currencyCodeSchema`, `moneyInputSchema`, `moneySchema`; types `AnyMoneySchemaOptions`, `MoneySchemaOptions`.
- `@arki/money/drizzle/pg`: Drizzle columns for Postgres that read and write `Money`. `moneyDecimal`, `moneyJson`, `moneyMinor`; types `MoneyDecimalConfig`, `MoneyJsonConfig`, `MoneyMinorConfig`.
- `@arki/money/drizzle/mysql`: Drizzle columns for MySQL and MariaDB that read and write `Money`. `moneyDecimal`, `moneyJson`, `moneyMinor`; types `MoneyDecimalConfig`, `MoneyJsonConfig`, `MoneyMinorConfig`.
- `@arki/money/drizzle/sqlite`: Drizzle columns for SQLite (libSQL, Turso, better-sqlite3, Bun SQLite, Cloudflare D1, Expo SQLite) that read and write `Money`. `moneyDecimal`, `moneyJson`, `moneyMinor`; types `MoneyDecimalConfig`, `MoneyJsonConfig`, `MoneyMinorConfig`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- There is no default rounding; an inexact step throws `RoundingNecessaryError`.
- Parsers return, builders throw: `Money.parse`, `Money.fromJSON`, `Currency.parse`, `parseMoney`, `fromStripeAmount` and `fromProviderUnits` return a `money.*` failure; `money()`, `Money.of` and `Currency.of` throw.
- Units are a `number` while safe and a `bigint` beyond 2^53. Both are exact.
- `Money<'EUR'>` and `Money<'USD'>` never mix; convert first.
- Currency decimals come from the shipped table, never from `Intl`.
